name: Tebra Design System — Figma build schema
muiSubstrate: @mui/material 5.15.12 (resolved from yarn.lock for '^5.15.11'; source read from .yarn/cache)
method: All values transcribed from source. Nothing was rendered, measured, or sampled from a browser.
targetPage: Button test — MCP (existing hand-transcribed reference to be replaced)

register.storedAs: append-only record store: records/<workstream>/<date>/<recordId>.json (immutable batch records), flags/active.json + flags/resolved.json, foundation/<section>.json; indexes/record-index.json and indexes/current-state.json are generated
register.aggregate: design-system-schema.json is generated from the store by scripts/schema/build-aggregate.js and is never edited by hand
